open.text: Every day, people face emergencies they were never trained for.

view.text: With AI glasses, the emergency dispatcher sees exactly what you see, hands-free.

scope.text: Cardiac arrest, severe bleeding, choking, an earthquake, a flood: one guide for any emergency.

ai.text: And until a dispatcher answers, an AI voice guides you through the first steps.

case.text: Here is one case we built end to end: a cardiac arrest.
